longContent.videoTitle: A deliberately long English video title that proves the two-line visual clamp only applies to controlled video metadata, while learning content remains readable.
longContent.crossVideoTitle: 跨视频笔记的长标题只允许单行受控省略，不能挤压时间戳、动作或正文内容。
longContent.prompt: Replace [PROVIDER] and [MODEL] in https://youtube-digest.example.test/remix/configuration/with-a-long-unbroken-technical-token.json before copying the editable local remix prompt.
longContent.error: A detailed error explanation must wrap beside its Retry or Open Settings action instead of being truncated or converted into an inaccessible colour-only indicator.
